Alex H: Kicking off smoke and integration checks now. will report back in ~5m.

Sara M: Quick check — does this include the new quantization flag? need to know for perf baselines.

Alex H: yes, flag `quant_profile=fp16-mixed` enabled, set on all inference pools. added note to release ticket.

db-admin-bot: DB check: no migrations detected for commit=9c2b7f1a. backups verified at 2026-03-22T00:40Z. :white_check_mark:

infra-watch: canary rollout started -> 10% traffic. health checks running.

QA-bot: running golden set validations (50 prompts). sampling chat and embed flows.

Sara M: if anything goes wrong we should be ready to rollback to tag v3.6.0. Alex, can you paste the revert commands?

Alex H: revert steps below — also we have a safety gate: auto-cut if 5m error rate exceeds 4%.

```
# revert to previous tag and reassign traffic
releasectl promote --env=prod --tag=v3.6.0
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/inference-runtime --replicas=3
# ensure config rollback
kubectl -n inference set env deployment/inference-runtime USE_NEW_CACHE=false
```

infra-watch: canary health: p95 latency stable, error_rate=0.9% (5m). :white_check_mark:

QA-bot: golden validations passed 48/50 (2 non-critical tokenization diffs). filing an eval ticket for follow-up.
